title: [menu widget] Documentation of templates.item seems outdated
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
The documentation for the `templates.item` of the Menu widget does not reflect the actual code.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/283419/40659914-ebd9cc8a-634f-11e8-89fe-105d85ac7f30.png)

I understand this as accepting either a string template, or a function taking three arguments (name, count and isRefined). The next line actually adds a fourth argument, `url`.

Actually, it seems that `templates.item`, when used in its function form actually only receive one argument; an object with the following keys: `count`, `cssClasses`, `data`, `isRefined`, `label`, `url` and `value`.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/283419/40659977-12198b38-6350-11e8-9eca-33e4bd4f9e0b.png)

**To Reproduce 🔍**
You can see the documentation on https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/menu.html#struct-MenuTemplates

**Expected behavior 💭**
I would expect the documentation to have the correct signature and explain what each key represents (I can guess most of them, except `data` that was always `null` in my tests).
